semantics: ical.js test/recur_iterator_test.js testRRULE(rule, options): start = ICAL.Time.fromString(options.dtStart or options.dates[0]); iterator = ICAL.Recur.fromString(rule).iterator(start); collects iterator.next().toString() up to max values, where max = options.max if given, else dates.length+1 for finite (COUNT/UNTIL) rules - so 'expected' is the complete instance list and the iterator must stop - else dates.length for infinite rules ('limit' = number of expected values). ICAL.RecurIterator does NOT emit a DTSTART that does not match the rule (e.g. MONTHLY;COUNT=10;BYDAY=1FR from 2012-01-07 starts 2012-02-03, and COUNT does not count it), so include_dtstart=false. All times are floating (no zone) or DATE values; noInstance:true cases expect the iterator to yield nothing (expected=[] with error=false). Commented-out tests in the source are not included. Note: ICAL.RecurExpansion (component-level expansion, not covered here) does include DTSTART.
